blocks.text: schema_version: the version of the body's format, so the receiver knows how to read it.
sent_at: when the event left the device. Not the same as signed_at.
The inspection record is the body. That part is Capulet's.
Friday at 2: demo for Ducal Freight. An inspection made offline syncing on reconnect, then its signed PDF.
After Friday: a pilot, if Ducal wants one. Sites and length to agree with Paris.
Before Friday: Mercutio's PDF layout and the demo run order.
Nothing gets a date in front of Ducal until it's built.
